name: The One That Got Away
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
narrative.objectives: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find the damned thing?
